description: RED-method deep dive for Hangfire job executions (span metrics from HangfireTracingFilter, operations locked to 'Hangfire *' span names) with per-job traces and correlated logs. Shows data only when jobs ran within the selected time range; locally trigger via k6 TRIGGER_JOBS.

panels.description: Executions per interval across all selected operations combined — spikes at the moments jobs ran.

targets.expr: round(sum((increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) unless traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"} offset $__rate_interval)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Total Requests

panels.description: FAILED executions per interval (red) plus completed runs that swallowed exceptions inside — dirty runs (orange).

targets.expr: round(sum((increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]) unless traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset $__rate_interval)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])))

round(sum((increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval]) unless traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset $__rate_interval)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Total Errors

targets.expr: round(sum by (span_name) ((increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) unless traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"} offset $__rate_interval)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Job execution time at the selected percentile (p50 / p95 / p99 via the Percentile variable) per operation.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(${percentile}, sum by (span_name, le) ((increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval]) unless traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"} offset $__rate_interval)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_bucket{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Runs that COMPLETED successfully but recorded exceptions inside (error.internal tag from TelemetryExceptions): per-item failures the job caught and skipped. Non-zero here with zero Failed runs means the job is 'succeeding dirty'.

targets.expr: floor(sum((increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range]) unless traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} offset $__range)) or increase(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service_name="$service", span_name=~"${operation:pipe}", error_internal="true", status_code!="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Runs with internal errors

panels.description: Job runs that completed successfully (root span OK) but recorded handled exceptions inside — root tagged error.internal by TelemetryExceptions. Click a trace to inspect which items failed and why. (Tag-based instead of {event:name="exception"}: Grafana's Tempo datasource 500s on event-scoped structural queries.)
